The stripes grow up out of the axis behind a scanning playhead with a light at its edge that reads out the year; a

templates.name: Rain Gauges
templates.description: / Two to five graduated glass rain gauges land in a row. Drops fall into each funnel (a streak above each) and every landing sends a ripple across the water as the column rises to its value on the shared scale; the reading rolls and rides the meniscus on the gauge's right. The narrated one (overlay.

templates.name: Dam Level
templates.description: / A dam and its reservoir in section on a canyon backdrop, an elevation scale up the left wall. The reservoir starts at full pool (overlay.total) and falls to the level (value + suffix), a pale bathtub ring appearing on the rock above it; each intake (items: label, value) flips from SUBMERGED to EXP

templates.name: Heat Sun
templates.description: / A tag for heat over the footage, top right: a sun pops in and turns its rays (long and short, breathing), wobbling heat rings ripple out from it and shift from gold to red as they fade. Beside it, right-aligned, a pulsing red dot and the warning (subtitle), the temperature rolling (a bare number o

templates.name: USA zoom
templates.description: The lower 48 fade up on a dark sea, then a spring camera dives (about 1.2 s) into the region bounding the places (default: the seven Colorado River Basin states). Target states fill brighter in the accent and their outlines draw on, the rest dim, state names rise out of masks with a pop tick each, places pin (white dot for cities, cyan ring for lakes and dams). Title bottom-left.

templates.name: Basin zoom
templates.description: Dark USA map: the lower 48 fade up and a mono UNITED STATES caption (overlay.label) pops at the map centroid, then the camera pushes (about 1.3 s, scale 1.6-2.6) onto the states holding the places, or the seven basin states by default. Targets tint in the accent with a soft glow and their outlines draw on while every other state dims; as the push settles each state's name rises out of a mask with a pop tick; city places get a white pin dot with a short label, lakes and dams a cyan ring. Title top-left.

templates.name: River network
templates.description: The seven basin states tinted on a dark USA, then the Colorado River draws itself source to sea (about 2 s) as a glowing cyan line with bright water streaming down it; the Green, Yampa, San Juan, Gunnison, Little Colorado, Virgin and Gila start from their heads the moment the mainstem's head passes their confluence. Tributary names pop at their midpoints with a tick (all of them, or only those named in items), Lake Powell, Lake Mead, Glen Canyon Dam and Hoover Dam light up as the river reaches them, the mainstem caption (overlay.label) sits at Lees Ferry and the places pin with names as the head passes. Title top-left.

templates.name: Basin split
templates.description: The basin states in two tints: the upper basin (Colorado, Wyoming, Utah, New Mexico) fills in the accent, then the lower basin (Arizona, Nevada, California) in desert sand, each outline drawing on and each state named. The compact's dividing line dashes along the Utah-Arizona border to Lees Ferry, which is marked and captioned; the two halves get their labels (items[0] / items[1], default UPPER BASIN / LOWER BASIN) with the items' values rolling beneath in overlay.suffix units. Title top-left.

templates.name: State callout
templates.description: The lower 48, then the camera pushes onto one state (the state holding locations[0], or the one named by overlay.label; Arizona by default). The state tints and glows, its outline draws on, the place pulses; a white callout line runs from it, elbows, and lands on a glass figure box on the right: a mono kicker (label or subtitle), the value rolling with its suffix, the text beneath. With no value the text is the headline of the box.

templates.name: Line Ticker
templates.description: A line chart on a dark clean canvas drawing point by point: every point pops in with a soft tick, a small value chip rides the head of the line, x labels rise as the head passes them, and when the last point lands its value parks in a badge - red when the series fell, the accent when it rose - with the change from the first point beside it. Small title top-left, the source bottom-left.

templates.name: Bars Ticker
templates.description: Horizontal bars on a dark clean canvas growing one after another in the given order, a soft tick as each lands and its value parking at the bar end with the unit; the largest bar (or the one the narration names) glows in the accent, the others run white to grey; dashed axis ticks above, the axis caption under the bars, the source bottom-left.

templates.name: Columns Ticker
templates.description: Vertical columns on a dark clean canvas rising one after another with a soft tick each, a white edge flashing as a column lands and its value rolling above it; the largest column (or the named one) in the accent; dashed grid with figures on the left, labels under the columns, the axis caption beneath, the source bottom-left.

templates.name: Planned vs Actual
templates.description: Two big columns on a dark clean canvas: the planned figure (items[0]) rises first in white, the actual (items[1]) second in red when it fell short or green when it beat the plan, each landing with a tick and its value rolling above; the planned level runs across as a dashed target, a diagonal drop line draws from one top to the other and the difference pops in a badge on it, the percent change and the absolute gap with its unit.

templates.name: Two Series Ticker
templates.description: Two lines on a dark clean canvas drawing point by point together, one tick per x: the first series from items[].value in the accent, the second from a number in items[].text in cyan (or, when there is none, a dashed smoothed TREND of the first); a legend top-right names them from overlay.label ('Inflow | Outflow'), the end values roll beside the last points, the source sits bottom-left.

templates.name: Snow Sites Dots
templates.description: Item values as dots along one horizontal axis on a dark clean canvas (GoMotion's SNOWPACK DEPTH sites): the dots land one after another with a tick and a shock ring, their names on thin leader lines above and below the axis, nice ticks with figures beneath, and the last dot is red, bigger, pulsing, and carries its value in a red pill; the axis caption under the axis, the source bottom-left.

templates.name: Tick Bars
templates.description: A data card on the scrim: horizontal bars in the given order, each growing expo-out with a bright bead riding its head, flashing a white edge as it lands, playing a soft tick and rolling its value at the bar end before parking it with the unit; the bar the narration names (else the largest) glows in the accent and breathes through the hold, the others run white to grey; dashed axis ticks above, the axis caption in mono caps beneath, the subtitle as a kicker over the title; negative values grow left of a zero line.

templates.name: Tick Line
templates.description: A data card on the scrim: a monotone line drawn segment by segment with a dwell on every point, each point popping with a shock ring and a soft tick while its value rises beside it (above when the line is falling, below when rising), a faint accent area following the head, x labels rising as the head passes, y ticks on the left; the last value lands in a pill - red when below the first, green when above - with the signed percent change, pulsing through the hold; overlay.highlight calls out one x label in the accent.

templates.name: Circle Row
templates.description: Outlined circles in a row on flat black (GoMotion's TUNNELS / CUTS): each ring draws on clockwise from 12 o'clock with a soft tick as it closes, the word rises inside in tracked caps, an optional value rolls under the circle, thin connectors then draw between neighbours; through the hold the circles take the accent one at a time, and at the end the rings unwind and the words drop; overlay.text as a tracked kicker top-centre.

templates.name: Network Tree
templates.description: A schematic on the case-file dark backdrop: a hub chip (overlay.label, accent edge) at the left, a trunk line drawing right and dropping to a bus that forks into right-angled branches, each popping a framed tile with a soft tick - a still from the overlay's media when there is one, else a dark tile with the node's initial and an accent corner - with its name beneath and items[].text as a sub-line; a bright comet keeps running down each branch in turn while the card holds, then the branches retract into the hub and the tiles shrink out.

templates.name: Wave Chain
templates.description: A concept diagram on flat black: a sine wave draws left to right with a glowing accent head, one half-period per item after the first; the first label sits at the wave's start and the rest at successive crests (above) and troughs (below), each popping a white node with an accent shock ring and a soft tick as the head arrives, the label rising in tracked caps - the endpoints larger - with items[].text as a mono sub-line; thin arrowheads on the wave between nodes read as '->', a green dot rides the wave back and forth through the hold, then the wave un-draws from its end and the labels drop.

templates.name: Persistent Percent Ring
templates.description: GoMotion's ring at the upper centre of the frame, built to ride across cuts: the track draws, the accent arc sweeps from 12 o'clock to value/total with a bright glowing head and a pop as it lands while the percent rolls inside; a dark chip with the noun ('OF CAPACITY REMAINING') and a mono subtitle rises beneath. Holds up to 12 s with only the head's 1.6 s breath and a 1.5% ring breath, then the arc unwinds and the number and chip drop out of their masks. Red below 25%, gold above, never green; no scrim, only a soft radial pool. No value: the chip text alone.

templates.name: Stat Ride
templates.description: A bare bold figure riding top-right on the footage the way GoMotion sets '3,491 FEET': no box or pill, DISPLAY white with a deep shadow over a soft radial pool, the unit in the accent at 0.42 of the size, the noun ('ACRE FEET', 'CUTS') on a line beneath or inline after a one-word noun, a small mono subtitle. Minus kept, thousands commas below 100k, compact 1.3M / 500K / 76K for round large integers, decimals as given, years without a comma. Rises out of its mask letter by letter while the digits roll, drifts 2-3 px on the hold, sinks back into the mask to leave. 'center' sets it giant mid-frame; compact halves it in a corner. No value: the noun alone as a word ride.

templates.name: Paper Checklist
templates.description: A cream paper card with a faint fibre texture pinned top-right by an accent push-pin, rotated -2 degrees over a soft pool: a red header tab carries the title ('TRIBUTARIES', or NOTES) with a tiny caption in its corner, rows in a handwritten face sit beside hand-drawn wobbly boxes, a mono footer holds the subtitle. The card slides down and settles, rows rise 4 frames apart, then one row per 0.55 s the box fills with the accent and a tick draws through it with a small pop (max 6). On the hold only the shadow breathes; to leave, the card lifts off its pin and slides out right. No items: the tab and an empty sheet with the subtitle.

templates.name: Quote Portrait
templates.description: Full-frame dark card: the speaker's photo in a ringed circle on the left (an accent arc turning round it, initials on a dark disc when there is no still), a big accent quote mark, and the quote typing in line by line in the serif italic with a blinking caret and a typewriter track; the name slides out of an accent rule with the role under it once the last line is typed.

templates.name: Name Tag
templates.description: A slim bar bottom-left riding on footage: an accent stripe, the name in bold condensed caps with a hairline growing under it and the role beneath; it slides in from the left out of a mask and slides back out at the end. For press photos and interview clips.

templates.name: Two Voices
templates.description: Two ringed portraits (media[0] and media[1], initials when a still is missing) turned toward each other over the dimmed footage, each with its position (items[].label) and its line (items[].text) rising beneath; a hairline divider draws out from an accent diamond between them. No 'VS' text.

templates.name: Statement Card
templates.description: A light paper card with an accent spine settles in over the dimmed footage; one bold sentence rises line by line, then a highlighter sweeps under the key phrase (overlay.highlight) in the accent word by word; the source sits under an accent dash. The card drops away at the end.

templates.name: Checklist Card
templates.description: A ruled paper card drops in with a bounce, titled with the text; the items (items[].label, an optional items[].text beside each) are checkbox rows that rise in and then tick one by one, each tick a drawn accent stroke with a small pop while the row's ink darkens; a footer counts them (overlay.label names what). The card slides away at the end.

templates.name: Circle List
templates.description: Full-frame black: three to five words (items[].label) in circles left to right, each ring drawing on with a pop as the word rises into it, three dots stepping across to the next; the highlighted word's ring is in the accent. A small tracked title (overlay.text) above.

templates.name: Hub Network
templates.description: A hub-and-spoke diagram over the dimmed footage: the text in an accent hub in the centre, the items (items[].label, items[].text under it) on nodes around it; a dotted line draws out to each node in turn with a pulse riding it, the node pops with a small photo tile when media has an entry for it (else a dark disc with the item's initial) and the label rises.

templates.name: Concept Wave
templates.description: A sine wave draws across the dimmed footage with a glowing head; up to three stops on it (crest, trough, crest) light up in turn as the head passes, each with its label (items[].label) rising and a small line (items[].text) under it, a chevron pointing on to the next. A tracked title top-left.

templates.name: Portrait Quote
templates.description: The footage darkens more on the left, where an accent opening mark and the serif italic quote rise line by line (at most four lines, shrinking before it cuts) with the highlight words in the accent; the name rises out of an accent rule with the role under it. On the right a 4:5 white-framed portrait slides in with a 3D turn and a gloss sweep (a dark medallion with the speaker's initials when there is no still). The lines drop and the frame slides out right at the end.

templates.name: Clean Typewriter
templates.description: The line types letter by letter (frame 6 on, 2 frames a character up to 48 characters, else 1) in a clean white sans on a soft dark gradient strip low-left, a blinking caret in the accent while it types; once typed, the key word (overlay.highlight, else the longest word) warms into the accent. An optional small kicker (label) sits above. Fades down and out at the end.

templates.name: Terminal Record
templates.description: A frosted dark glass card mid-left with a window dot row and a small record label (label, default RECORD); the fact types letter by letter in a monospace face after an accent prompt, with a blinking caret. For records, figures and log entries.

templates.name: Word by Word
templates.description: A centred kinetic caption: the words land one at a time with a small rise and settle out of a soft blur, the key word (highlight, else the longest) in the accent with a soft glow, over a gentle radial shade.

templates.name: Marker Highlight
templates.description: A clean white paper strip slides up low-left with dark ink text; a translucent yellow highlighter then sweeps across the key words (highlight, else the one or two longest words) in reading order. No underline, no red.

templates.name: Cinematic Blur-In
templates.description: A cinematic letter-spaced title in the centre: the letters come out of a blur from the middle outward while the tracking tightens, a thin white rule grows beneath and an optional small line (label) fades in under it. Blurs away at the end.

templates.name: Split Reveal
templates.description: The headline split into two lines that slide in from opposite sides behind their masks and meet in the centre, a short accent bar growing between them; they slide back out the way they came.

templates.name: Box Stack
templates.description: Two to four words in solid boxes stacked on the left with an offset, a warm yellow box then a white box, black condensed caps, each popping in with an overshoot; they fold away one by one at the end.

templates.name: News Clipping
templates.description: A newspaper headline clipping: a heavy serif headline on textured newsprint under a double rule and a small dateline (label), torn top and bottom edges; it slides in rotated from below and settles at a slight angle with a soft shadow.

templates.name: Glass Caption
templates.description: A modern frosted-glass pill bottom-centre with a small info icon in the accent; the line reveals left to right inside it. A caption for a fact, never louder than the picture.

templates.name: Outline Fill
templates.description: A big outlined title in condensed caps, centred; it fills with colour (the accent, lightened) left to right behind a soft glowing front, the fill landing on frame 36, then holds.

templates.name: Side Note
templates.description: A small editor's annotation in handwriting in the upper right, written on left to right, with a hand-drawn arrow in the accent curving down into the frame toward the subject.

templates.name: Typed Quote
templates.description: A serif quotation typed letter by letter (frame 6 on, 2 frames a character up to 48 characters, else 1) over a darkened left side, large soft quote marks behind it in the accent; once typed, an accent dash and the attribution (label) slide in.

templates.name: Drawn Question
templates.description: The narration's question in large clean type, rising word by word in the centre; a big question mark then draws itself beside it in the accent and its dot lands on frame 26.

templates.name: Alert Bar
templates.description: A clean warning bar upper left: an amber icon cell (red for life-threatening words such as evacuation or emergency) drops in with its triangle pulsing, a dark bar wipes out of it and the text slides in; an optional kicker (label) above. Wipes away at the end.

templates.name: Clean Date Card
templates.description: A bold deep-navy date card with a yellow top edge: the month in a solid yellow block, the day huge on the left counting up to its value and landing with a small punch on frame 28, the year and the weekday (computed, or label) beside it; a place (label) under the card. Month-year or year-only dates count the year; a time alone shows big.

templates.name: Calendar Page
templates.description: A calendar month page flips down from its binding, its grid laid out from the real first weekday; a red marker circles the day (frame 22), then the weekday and full date settle under the page in a navy tag.

templates.name: Date Stamp Bar
templates.description: A bold lower-left bar, THURSDAY • SEPT 25, 2026 (and the time when given), revealed by a yellow block that sweeps across it and slides off; the place (label) sits under it. Wipes away to the left at the end.

templates.name: Clock Time
templates.description: An analog clock mid-left whose hands spin round and stop exactly on the time (frame 30), the second hand sweeping on; the digital time big beside it with AM/PM in a yellow block and the weekday, date or place under it.

templates.name: REC Timestamp
templates.description: A camcorder on-screen display over the footage: thin viewfinder corners, a blinking red REC dot and a monospace timestamp top-right, SEP 25 2026  03:45:07 PM, the seconds running. Clicks on at frame 3; good over news and phone clips.

templates.name: Date Slam
templates.description: A full-width band across the middle: a yellow wipe, then navy over it; the month (yellow), day and year (white numerals) slam down one after another with a small camera shake, the day landing on frame 18; the weekday or place under them. Wipes off to the right.

templates.name: Timeline Tick
templates.description: A thin month ruler (a year ruler when only the year is known) slides in across the lower third and decelerates; a yellow marker drops onto the exact date (frame 22) with a navy label card, and the month's tick label turns yellow.

templates.name: Days Later
templates.description: For a span of time in the text (3 DAYS LATER, 48 HOURS, TWO WEEKS EARLIER): the number counts up big in yellow, the unit and the word after it stacked beside it in white, a time bar filling under them with a tick per unit. Text without a span falls back to the date card.

templates.name: Bold Date Headline
templates.description: The date as a huge bold headline: SEPTEMBER 30 slams onto a solid yellow block (the theme's colour when one is set), punching down from larger with a motion blur and landing on frame 11 with a small camera shake; the weekday rises above it in white and the year, time or place sits letter-spaced under it. Ranges read TUESDAY → THURSDAY, SEPT 28 → OCT 2 or SEPTEMBER 28-30; a time alone headlines with its weekday over it; words like TOMORROW NIGHT go on the block as they are.

templates.name: Big Date Stack
templates.description: Stacked bold typography left of centre: the day number huge in white (330-440 px), the month in a solid yellow bar locked to the number's width, the weekday, year and place small and letter-spaced under them. The stack punches in from larger with a motion blur and lands on frame 8 with a small bump while the bar wipes open; a weekday, a month or a year alone takes the big line, a day range reads 28-30.

templates.name: Clean Date (Letter Reveal)
templates.description: The date or time and nothing else, in clean Anton caps (about 55 px tall at 1080p), low on the left or the right at the safe margin: the letters slide up out of a mask one by one with a soft digital tick each (no hit), the weekday, year or place in small tracked caps under it; a time reads as the big figure with AM/PM and the zone small beside it. Four letterings turn from one date to the next (Text style): clean white with a thin amber rule, silver with a light sweep, the day in amber, white on a soft feathered shade. Reads 'SEPTEMBER 29', 'TUESDAY NIGHT', '3:45 PM', '8 AM ET', 'WED → THU'.

templates.name: Clean Count
templates.description: The figure counts up from zero in big clean tabular numerals with thousands separators and a soft eased landing; a thin accent line draws beneath it and the label rises under the line. Prefix and unit ride the same baseline.

templates.name: Rolling Digits
templates.description: Slot-machine drums, one dark tile per digit, spin and land one by one from left to right, each tile flashing the accent as it settles; separators and the unit fade in, the label rises beneath.

templates.name: Bar Percent
templates.description: On a dark glass panel the label sits left and the percent counts up right while a wide horizontal bar fills in sync with a glowing head, over 0 / 50 / 100% marks; a quiet second line underneath.

templates.name: Ring Gauge Pro
templates.description: A ring gauge whose gradient arc sweeps round from twelve o'clock in step with the count, rounded glowing head, a tick bezel that lights as the arc passes; the clean percent in the centre and the label below.

templates.name: People Grid
templates.description: A 10 x 10 grid of little people fills in the accent to the percent while the number counts beside it, with an 'N IN EVERY 100' line, a short accent rule and the label.

templates.name: Split Compare
templates.description: Two dark panels swipe in from either side and meet round an accent arrow badge; each has its label and a figure counting up together (before and after, or A against B). Reads overlay.items [{label, value}].

templates.name: Corner Stat
templates.description: A compact stat card clicks into the top-right corner over the footage: an accent edge, the figure counting up and a one-line label; it slides back out to the right. Rides on the picture, no scrim.

templates.name: Pie Slice
templates.description: A pie whose share sweeps in with the count, then the slice pulls out of the pie with a white edge and a shadow; the percent, a short accent rule and the label beside it.

templates.name: Money Stack
templates.description: Money counts up with its currency sign while a stack of banknotes drops on beside it, note by note; large amounts read as '$4.2 BILLION', with the label under a short accent rule.

templates.name: Zoom Circle Marker
templates.description: A slow push toward a point of the photo, then a red hand-drawn marker loop is drawn round it and a white label with a red hand-drawn arrow points at it (overlay.anchor {x,y} in 0..1, else an off-centre point).

templates.name: Highlight Box
templates.description: The photo dims and desaturates outside a red box that draws on around the point of interest, a red tag names it, then the camera pushes into the box.

templates.name: Focus Pull
templates.description: The still starts soft and dark and racks into focus under a diagonal light sweep and a vignette while the camera pushes; the caption fades up lower left.

templates.name: Split Panels
templates.description: The photo arrives as three vertical strips sliding in staggered from above and below, then the gaps close into one picture that keeps pushing; caption lower left.

templates.name: Framed Print Drop
templates.description: A framed print with a white mat drops onto a dark desk, lands with a small bump and settles its turn, and the camera leans in; a museum-style label card slides in beside it.

templates.name: Parallax 2.5D
templates.description: 2.5D parallax: a blurred, darkened copy of the photo drifts one way behind a sharp framed crop that drifts the other, with its caption inside the crop.

templates.name: Newsprint Halftone
templates.description: A newspaper page slides up and settles: a double rule, the kicker, the headline (overlay.text) in a serif strip and the photo printed in halftone dots under it, a serif-italic caption; the camera leans in.

templates.name: Punch In
templates.description: A fast zoom-blur punch into the photo with a light exposure flash, settling at once into a slow sideways drift; caption lower left.

templates.name: Duotone Caption
templates.description: The photo wipes in on a diagonal in a duotone grade (near-black to a light tint of the accent) with a big clean caption, an accent rule above it and a letter-spaced subtitle.

templates.name: Light Sweep Location
templates.description: A slow push with a warm diagonal light sweep, vignette and film grain; a small location label with an accent pin, a drawn hairline and a second line.

templates.name: Polaroid Pan
templates.description: A shutter flash, then the photo is an instant print on a warm tabletop that the camera pans across; the caption is handwritten on the print letter by letter, a date beside it.

templates.name: Case File Photo
templates.description: The photo as a print clipped into a manila case folder on a dark desk (a paper clip, the folder tab with the label, a typed report underneath): the print drops onto the folder and lands on frame 13, a typed label strip with the text is taped on under it, a red marker circle is drawn round the point (overlay.anchor {x, y[, r]} in 0..1 of the picture, else an off-centre point) and the camera pushes slowly into the circle.

templates.name: Circle Spotlight
templates.description: The photo dims, desaturates and softens everywhere except a circle of light that opens on the point (overlay.anchor {x, y[, r]}, else an off-centre point); a red ring draws round it from frame 10 with a thin white halo, and a short label rises beside it on a thin white leader line with a red dot. The camera drifts in about the point; at the exit the ring erases and the iris opens back to the whole picture.

templates.name: Magnifying Glass
templates.description: A magnifying glass (dark metal rim, glass glare, wooden handle, a soft shadow on the photo) glides in from the lower right on a curve and settles over the point at frame 22 (overlay.anchor {x, y[, r]}, else an off-centre point), showing the detail about twice as large; it floats while it holds, a white label card pops beside it, and it lifts away at the exit.

templates.name: Red Arrow on Photo
templates.description: A bold label card pops up clear of the point, then a hand-drawn red felt-marker arrow sweeps out of it on a bowed curve and its head flicks open on the point at frame 21 (overlay.anchor {x, y[, r]}, else an off-centre point), while the camera pushes slowly in about the point; the arrow is erased from its tail at the exit.

templates.name: Profile Intro
templates.description: A blurred copy of the portrait fills the frame; the framed portrait slides in on the left with an accent bar, the name large in condensed caps on the right over an accent bar and hairline, the kicker above and the role beneath. Initials medallion when there is no portrait.

templates.name: Dossier Intro
templates.description: A manila file folder slides up on a dark desk; the portrait is paper-clipped to the sheet and the name is typed letter by letter with a caret (typing from frame 6), then highlighted; the role is filled in after it.

templates.name: Split Name
templates.description: The portrait swipes in to fill the right half in a duotone of the accent behind an accent seam; the name in big clean type on the left with a line drawing under it, kicker above and role below.

templates.name: Spotlight Intro
templates.description: A dark stage: a spotlight hits the portrait with a flicker, the kicker and the name below in a serif with a thin accent underline drawing out from its centre, the role in spaced caps.

templates.name: Magazine Cover
templates.description: A shutter flash and the portrait fills the frame as a magazine cover: the name as a serif masthead dropping in letter by letter, a thin frame line, the kicker and the role as the cover line lower left.

templates.name: Forecast Wind Flow
templates.description: The forecast-model view news-weather channels screen-record: a smooth colour field of wind speed (blue to magenta) over the region's state and coast lines, thousands of white streaks spiralling into the storm's low, city dots with names, a speed legend and a model-time chip; the camera drifts in slowly.

templates.name: Forecast Rain Bands
templates.description: The same forecast-model view as precipitation: green, yellow and red rain bands wrapping around the low, slowly turning, with streaks of the flow, state lines, city names, an intensity legend and a model-time chip.

templates.name: Red Arrow on Video
templates.description: Rides on the playing clip: a bold white label card pops up clear of the thing and a hand-drawn red felt-marker arrow sweeps out of it, its head flicking open on the thing at frame 18 (the swipe peaks mid-sweep, frame 14). Needs overlay.anchor {x, y[, r]} in 0..1 of the frame (src/anchors.find_anchor on the clip's frame); draws nothing without one.

templates.name: Red Circle on Video
templates.description: Rides on the playing clip: a red felt-marker loop draws a little more than once round the thing (frame 3 on) and pulses once with a soft ring going out; a white label card on a red tick beside it when text is given. Needs overlay.anchor {x, y[, r, w, h]} in 0..1 of the frame; draws nothing without one.

templates.name: Red Box on Video
templates.description: Rides on the playing clip: a red box draws round the thing from its top-left corner while the rest of the frame dims a touch, and a red tag with the name slides out of the box's edge. Needs overlay.anchor {x, y[, r, w, h]} in 0..1 of the frame (w, h size the box); draws nothing without one.

templates.name: Rolling Count
templates.description: The number and nothing else: Anton digits roll into place like an odometer (every column easing out, the units spinning fastest) with a soft digital tick on each change and no landing hit; commas, %, $ and K/M/B in place, a unit word small beside the figure, what it counts in small tracked caps under it once it lands. Low on the left or the right at the safe margin; four letterings turn from one figure to the next (Text style).

templates.name: Key Phrase Lower Third
templates.description: A key phrase low at the side on up to two lines: a thin amber rule grows beside it, the lines rise out of a clean mask one after the other with a small settle and the key word (highlight, else the longest) warms to amber; a small tracked line under it. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks, then takes two lines. A text swoosh on the entrance; the lines drop back into the mask over the last 11 frames.

templates.name: Quote Line
templates.description: A spoken quote on up to two lines under a large faint amber quote mark, no box: the mark fades up, the lines rise out of a clean mask, then the speaker (label) and role (subtitle) follow a short amber rule in small tracked caps. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks, then takes two lines. A soft paper slide as it comes in.

templates.name: Headline Word by Word
templates.description: A headline revealed word by word: each word rises out of a clean mask with a small settle and a soft letter tick, the key word (highlight, else the longest) in amber, then a short amber rule draws under it. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks, then takes two lines. The words drop back into the mask over the last 11 frames.

templates.name: Breaking Tag
templates.description: A minimal news tag: BREAKING (or the label) wipes in in amber tracked caps and a thin amber rule draws out beside it - no red box - then the headline rises under it out of a clean mask. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks, then takes two lines. A soft whoosh with the rule and a text swoosh on the headline.

templates.name: Question Line
templates.description: The narration's question (SO WHY IS THIS HAPPENING?) word by word in the lower third, each word rising out of a clean mask with a soft letter tick, the question mark in amber, a short amber rule under it once it has landed. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks, then takes two lines. Centred by default; left or right by Placement.

templates.name: Bullet Trio
templates.description: Three short lines, staggered: an amber dot pops in, then its line rises out of a clean mask beside it, a soft UI pop per bullet. Items from the list, else the text cut at bars, semicolons or commas. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks to fit. One size for the three lines.

templates.name: What We Know
templates.description: A WHAT WE KNOW list (or the label): the title rises over a thin amber rule, then three numbered items come up one by one in small tracked caps, an amber 01 / 02 / 03 before each and a soft UI pop each. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks to fit. Items from the list, else the text cut at bars or semicolons.

templates.name: Mini Timeline Row
templates.description: Three points on one thin line, text only: the line draws left to right and as it reaches each point a small dot pops, the date rises above it (the last in amber) and what happened fades up under it in small tracked caps. Items (label = when, text = what), else the text cut at bars, each led by its date. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks to fit. Two to four points.

templates.name: Before / After Labels
templates.description: BEFORE over the left half and AFTER over the right half of a split (top and bottom on a vertical video), at the 96 px safe margin: each word rises out of a clean mask over its thin rule (white, then amber), a date or note small under it. Labels from the items, else the text cut at a bar; notes from the items or the subtitle (2019 | 2026). Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks to fit. A text swoosh for each.

templates.name: Underline Sweep
templates.description: A phrase on up to two lines rises out of a clean mask, then an amber underline sweeps under its key words (highlight, else the longest) in reading order and they turn amber as it passes; the underline pulls back before the words drop out. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks, then takes two lines. A text swoosh on the entrance, the marker underline on the sweep.

templates.name: Kicker + Headline
templates.description: A small kicker in tracked caps (label; else the words before a colon) wipes in after a short amber rule, then the headline rises under it out of a clean mask, the key word in amber. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks, then takes two lines. A soft whoosh with the kicker, a text swoosh on the headline.

templates.name: Minimal Chapter Title
templates.description: A minimal chapter title in the middle of the frame: small amber caps (label, else CHAPTER and the value in words) between two thin rules drawing outward, the title rising under them out of a clean mask, an optional small line under it. Clean white Anton caps with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box), the key word in amber, 96 px safe margins; a long line shrinks, then takes two lines. A soft whoosh with the rules, a text swoosh on the title.

templates.name: Location Tag (Pin)
templates.description: Top left at the 96 px safe margin: a small amber map pin falls onto the line, squashes a little and a ring spreads once from its tip; the place in clean white Anton caps (~40 px tall at 1080p, soft dark shadow, no box) slides out from behind the pin, an optional small line in tracked caps under it. Reads 'ATLANTIC CITY, NJ'. Pin-drop sound on the landing.

templates.name: Region Label
templates.description: Lower left, a quarter up (clear of the captions): the region in clean Anton caps (~46 px) rises out of a mask, a thin amber divider grows beside it and the area slides out from behind it in small tracked caps, all on one line ('NORTH CAROLINA | OUTER BANKS'); a long pair stacks with a short amber rule. Soft shadow only, no box.

templates.name: Section Marker (Now)
templates.description: A region change: 'NOW' small in amber caps on a thin amber rule that draws out, the new region in clean Anton caps (~52 px) drops out from under the rule with a small settle; lower left, a quarter up. Reads 'NOW: NEW JERSEY', 'BACK TO FLORIDA', 'MEANWHILE · TEXAS'.

templates.name: Route Label (Road Status)
templates.description: A small road in perspective draws up (its amber centre dashes running), the route in clean Anton caps (~46 px) slides out beside it and its status rises in amber: 'NC-12 CLOSED', 'I-95 SOUTHBOUND FLOODED'; the place small under it. Lower left, no shield box.

templates.name: River Gauge Label
templates.description: Three short waves (the top one amber) flow in from the left, the river in clean Anton caps (~46 px) rises out of a mask, the gauge in small tracked caps under it with a reading in amber from value and unit: 'HUDSON RIVER' over 'SANDY HOOK · 8.4 FT'. Lower left.

templates.name: Distance Line
templates.description: A distance as said: the figure in clean Anton caps (~50 px) rises over a thin scale bar that measures itself out (an amber dot riding to its end tick), where from in small tracked caps under it: '31 MILES' / 'NORTH OF DALLAS'. Spoken numbers in digits; value and unit when given. Lower left.

templates.name: Coordinates Tag
templates.description: Small mono coordinates: a thin crosshair turns in, the latitude and longitude decode digit by digit with soft digital ticks and lock by frame 30, the place in small amber caps under them. From the overlay's place (gazetteer) or read off the text ('39.36 N 74.42 W'); lower left.

templates.name: Source Credit
templates.description: Tiny, bottom right at the safe margin: the source word in amber and the name in white tracked caps part from a hairline divider: 'VIDEO | @STORMCHASER', 'VIA | STORM CHASER', 'COURTESY | NWS'. Holds quietly and slides back into the hairline.

templates.name: Footage Tag
templates.description: Minimal, top right: a small mark pops (a viewfinder for drone or camera views, a pulsing amber dot for LIVE, an amber dot for archive film) and the footage type slides out in tracked caps as its spacing closes, a year in amber: 'DRONE VIEW', 'LIVE CAM', 'ARCHIVE 2012'.

templates.name: Warning Label
templates.description: A small amber alert mark pops, the warning in clean Anton caps (~46 px) slides out beside it with the alert word in amber ('FLOOD WARNING'), a thin amber rule draws under it and the details follow in small caps ('UNTIL 8 PM · ATLANTIC COUNTY'). No red box. Lower left.

templates.name: Place and Time
templates.description: Top left: the place in clean Anton caps (~40 px) rises out of a mask, a thin amber divider grows, the local time slides out beside it with AM / PM small in amber: 'ATLANTIC CITY | 6:40 AM'. A day or note small under it.

templates.name: Where Lower Third
templates.description: The WHERE lower third: a thin amber bar grows down the left edge, the place in clean Anton caps (~54 px) slides out from behind it, the county and state follow in small tracked caps, over a soft feathered shade (no box, no band). Lower left, a quarter up.

templates.name: Time Stamp (Top Left)
templates.description: A clock time as a clean stamp in the top-left corner at the 96 px safe margin: a thin amber tick draws down, the figures ('3:45', '8:00') rise out of a mask 2 frames apart with a small settle, AM/PM (amber) and the zone stacked small beside them, the weekday or place in small tracked caps under it. White Anton (cap ~54 px at 1080p) with a soft dark shadow and a feathered shade, no box. Soft letter ticks as the figures land; out over the last 11 frames.

templates.name: Date (Top Center)
templates.description: The date centred at the top: 'SEPTEMBER 26' rises out of a mask from the middle out, the day in amber, a short amber hairline draws under it and the weekday and year come in small and tracked. Clean Anton caps (cap ~52 px at 1080p), a soft dark shadow and a feathered shade, no box. A soft text swoosh and letter ticks as the pairs land.

templates.name: Dateline (Bottom Left)
templates.description: A dateline in the bottom-left corner: 'SATURDAY • ATLANTIC CITY' as one clean Anton line (cap ~44 px at 1080p) rising letter by letter, an amber dot between the day and the place, the full date small under it. Reads 'day · place' text, or a date with the place in Label / Subtitle. Soft shadow, feathered shade, no box.

templates.name: Date Range (Arrow)
templates.description: A span of dates low on the left: the first end rises ('SEP 26'), an amber arrow draws across, the second end rises after it ('SEP 28'); the length ('3 DAYS') and the year small under it. Reads month-day, weekday, year and clock ranges ('Monday through Wednesday', '1983 to 2026', '3 PM - 5 PM'). Clean Anton caps, soft shadow, no box.

templates.name: Day Marker (Top Right)
templates.description: 'DAY 3' in the top-right corner: the word rises letter by letter and the figure rolls up to its value in amber like an odometer; what it counts ('OF THE SEARCH') small under it. Reads 'day three', 'the third day', 'WEEK 2'; Value sets the figure. Clean Anton caps, soft shadow, no box.

templates.name: Time of Day (Lower Left)
templates.description: When it happens, low on the left: 'TONIGHT 8 PM', 'TOMORROW MORNING' in clean Anton caps rising letter by letter; the time (or the part of the day) lands white and warms to amber; a place or weekday small under it. Soft shadow, feathered shade, no box.

templates.name: Lead Time (Next 72 Hours)
templates.description: A lead time low on the right: 'NEXT' small and tracked, the figure counting up in amber in equal digit cells with its unit beside it ('72 HOURS'), a hairline under it filling with amber like a time window; what follows ('UNTIL LANDFALL') small under it. Reads 'in 48 hours', 'over the next seventy-two hours', 'within 3 days'. Clean Anton caps, soft shadow, no box.

templates.name: Updated Stamp (Top Left)
templates.description: A small stamp in the top-left corner: an amber dot, 'UPDATED' in small tracked caps and the time in Anton ('6:00') with AM (amber) and the zone beside it. Reads 'AS OF 9:30 PM ET', 'ISSUED SEPT 26'. Soft shadow, a light feathered shade, no box.

templates.name: Week Strip
templates.description: A minimal week, low in the centre: the date in clean Anton over MON TUE WED THU FRI SAT SUN in small tracked caps fading in one by one; an amber underline slides along to the day, which warms to amber. Text only, no box; soft shadow and a feathered shade.

templates.name: Weekday Over Date (Bottom Right)
templates.description: The weekday small in amber tracked caps over the date in clean Anton ('SATURDAY' / 'SEPTEMBER 26') in the bottom-right corner, the year or place small under it; the weekday fades in as its tracking settles, the date rises letter by letter. Soft shadow, feathered shade, no box.

templates.name: Year Marker (History)
templates.description: A year for a moment in history, low on the left: '1937' in clean Anton (cap ~62 px at 1080p) rises digit by digit, an amber line runs out from it to a small node, the day and the place small under it. Reads 'May 6, 1937', 'the 1930s'. Soft shadow, feathered shade, no box.

templates.name: Relative Time Tag
templates.description: When it happened, said plainly, in the top-left corner: an amber dash draws and 'LAST NIGHT' / 'THIS MORNING' rises letter by letter in clean Anton; the time or place small under it. Picks the phrase out of a longer line. Soft shadow, feathered shade, no box.

templates.name: Live Clock (Top Right)
templates.description: A clock time in the top-right corner with a tiny pulsing red live dot (no box): the figures rise out of a mask, AM/PM (amber) and the zone stacked small beside them, the colon breathing once a second; the place small under it. Clean Anton caps, soft shadow, feathered shade.

templates.name: Lower-Third Count
templates.description: The figure in the lower third with what it counts beside it on its baseline (one or two lines of tracked caps), a small amber kicker over it (subtitle or label) and a hairline under it drawing out from an amber lead. The digits roll like an odometer and land at frame 32. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Percent Line
templates.description: A percent counting up (caps 60 px) over a thin track whose amber fill runs to the share in step with the count, a bright head on its end and quarter ticks; what it is a share of in tracked caps under it. Lands at frame 34. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Rainfall Total
templates.description: A rainfall total: a small vector cloud with drops falling from it beside the figure, INCHES (and OF RAIN) in tracked caps beside the digits, where or when under it. For lines about rain (the planner's _LOOK_NEEDS). Lands at frame 33. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Wind Gauge
templates.description: A wind speed beside a minimal dial: a 240-degree track, an amber arc and a white needle sweeping to the speed on a round scale (a small flutter once it lands), MPH over GUSTS in tracked caps beside the figure. For lines about wind (the planner's _LOOK_NEEDS). Lands at frame 34. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Big Figure
templates.description: One large figure (caps 72 px) rolling into place, what it counts under it in tracked caps with its last word in amber ('WITHOUT POWER'), a subtitle smaller under that. Lands at frame 36. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Two Figures
templates.description: Two figures compared side by side ('22%  VS  45%'): the first white, the second amber, a small amber VS between them, each figure's label (a year, then / now) under it and what they measure under both. From the first two items with values, else the first two numbers in the words; one number draws the big figure. The first lands at 28, the second at 38. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Trend Arrow
templates.description: A figure with a small amber arrow beside it rising into place (pointing down for the planner's label 'down', a negative value or 'fell / dropped / declined' in the words) and nudging once as the digits land, what changed under it. Lands at frame 34. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Rank
templates.description: A rank: '#' small and amber at the cap top, the place rolling down from the 9s to it ('#1'), an amber hairline and what it ranks beside it in one or two lines of tracked caps. The rank from value or the words ('#1', 'No. 1', 'number one', 'first', '3rd'). Lands at frame 30. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Split Stat
templates.description: Two or three figures with their words on one line ('3 DEAD · 12 MISSING'), parted by amber dots, each rolling in turn (8 frames apart) and its word arriving as it lands, the later words in amber; where or when under them. From items with values, else every 'N WORD' in the words. The first lands at 28, the second at 36. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Water Level
templates.description: A river or lake level ('8.9 FT') beside a slim staff gauge: a scale with ticks, the water rising to the level with a gentle moving line, and a dashed amber flood-stage mark when a flood stage is said ('flood stage 7 ft' in the words or subtitle, or total with 'flood' said), named in amber in the line under the figure. For lines about rivers, lakes and floods (the planner's _LOOK_NEEDS). Lands at frame 34. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Temperature
templates.description: A temperature ('102°F', the degree sign and scale small at the cap top) beside a slim thermometer whose column rises with the count - amber when hot, ice when freezing, white between; what and where under it. For lines about heat and cold (the planner's _LOOK_NEEDS). Lands at frame 34. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Money Figure
templates.description: A sum of money: '$' small and amber at the cap top, the figure rolling ('1.2'), the scale word beside it (BILLION; a raw 1,200,000,000 is written 1.2 BILLION) with a short label stacked under it in amber ('IN DAMAGE'), else the label under the figure. Lands at frame 34. Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Step Counter
templates.description: A step or score ('3 OF 5'): the digit steps up one at a time (a soft tick each) while a row of thin segments lights in amber in step, 'OF 5' small beside it, what it counts under the row. From value and total, or 'N of M' / 'N out of M' in the words. Lands at frame 28 for 3 of 5 (8 + 7 per step). Clean white Anton figures with a soft dark shadow (no stroke, no box; a feathered shade at most), amber accents, 96 px safe margins, low left or right (Placement). Sound built in: a soft digit tick on each change (never two within 2 frames) and a soft count-final click on the landing - never a hit.

templates.name: Big Date (Centred)
templates.description: VidRush's big date, always centred: the date exactly as said on line 1 ('23 September' / 'SEPTEMBER 23') and the year (subtitle, or a year ending the words) at about half its size under it. The letters fade in left to right (blur 4 -> 0 px, 6 px rise, 1.2 frames apart), the year 6 frames later. theme typewriter (red, the default): white Courier Prime Bold in title case (cap ~92 px at 1080p, never wider than 66% of the frame), a soft shadow, a crimson marker box wiping in behind line 1 from frame 26. theme serif (gold): warm-white Cinzel caps (cap ~64 px, tracked) on a full-width dark band, thin dashes either side, the year under the band. No weekday, nothing the narration did not say. Fades out over the last 10 frames.

templates.name: Time Card (Top Left)
templates.description: VidRush's time tag, always top-left (card's left edge 64 px, top 56 px at 1080p): a rounded card holding the time as said ('9:08 AM', '21:40'), black figures (cap ~50 px) with AM/PM at half size on the same line. theme typewriter (red, the default): a crimson card with darker diagonal stripes and Courier Prime Bold figures; theme serif (gold): a flat gold card and Playfair Display 900 figures. The card scales 0.92 -> 1 and fades in over 6 frames, the figures type in one every 3 frames, and a black label strip (subtitle: a place or a date, white bold caps) drops 8 px into place under it, overlapping the card. Fades out over the last 8 frames.

templates.name: Typed Caption (Bottom Left)
templates.description: VidRush's typed caption, always bottom-left (x 96 px, baseline ~960 px at 1080p): a short caption as said ('Parker Dam, 1938', 'University of Hawaii, 1959', up to ~42 characters) in cream Courier Prime Bold (cap ~34 px) with a soft shadow over a soft bottom-left darkening. It types one character every 2 frames from frame 6 (the typing contract), a thin cursor follows and blinks for 20 frames after the last letter, holds, and fades out over the last 10 frames.

templates.name: Year on a Line (Centred)
templates.description: VidRush's year on a line, always centred: a thin white line (1100 px, ends fading out) fades in, a small glowing white dot slides from its right end to the centre over 40 frames (ease in-out) and the year under it counts in whole years from total (the start, default 2026) to value (the year said; else a year in the words), landing exactly on it. The label, if any, comes in small and tracked under the year once it lands. Fades out over the last 10 frames.

templates.name: Line Chart (Endpoint Called Out)
templates.description: A Bloomberg-style line chart that draws with the camera: it opens close on the first point, follows the line's glowing head as it draws through the years (x to time scale when the labels are years, a monotone curve with no fake plateaus), then pulls back to the whole chart. Each point pops as the line passes it; the first value sits small beside its point and the last lands at frame 50 with a pulse and its value and year called out beside it. Title top-left (text, label as a kicker), source bottom-left (subtitle). Sound: a soft tick per point, one count-final click on the landing - never a whoosh.

templates.name: Ghost Bars (Then and Now)
templates.description: Then vs now in two thick bars: the earlier value grows and counts, then its dashed ghost appears on the later row and the later bar grows inside it; the gap between them fills with accent hatching and the change lands in a pill at frame 45 - in points for two percentages ('-73 PTS'), else in percent. Uses the first and the last item. Ticks while each value counts, a click as it lands.

templates.name: Nested Squares to Scale
templates.description: Two or three quantities as area-true squares from one corner (Vox style): the largest draws its outline and fills faintly, the smaller grows out of the shared corner in the accent and lands at frame 40, each value counting at its square's corner with its label; the ratio of the largest to the smallest ('4.6x') stands beside them over the two labels as a fraction.

templates.name: Unit Chart Split
templates.description: A hundred units (people, drawn clean, when the line counts people; else dots) on a darkened, blurred frame: the share lights up in the accent column by column while the figure counts, lands at frame 38, then the lit units separate from the rest. 'One in four' (value 1, total 4) draws four large units, one lit. What it counts (text) sits under the figure.

templates.name: Water-Filled Figure
templates.description: The percentage as a giant outlined Anton figure on the left: its outline draws on, then water rises inside the letters to the share (a gentle wave on the surface, a little slosh as it lands at frame 42) while the number counts; what it is (text) and its unit line (subtitle) come in beside it. For a reservoir, a lake or a capacity (the planner's _LOOK_NEEDS).

templates.name: Capacity Gauge (E to F)
templates.description: A fuel gauge for a reservoir: a dark glass half-dial, E to F, ticks with the low quarter in the accent; the needle swings from E to the share with a small overshoot and settles at frame 38 while the arc fills behind it and the figure counts under the hub, its word (subtitle, 'FULL') beside it and the subject (text) over the dial.

templates.name: Drum Counter
templates.description: A mechanical counter on a frosted plate: each digit on its own lit drum (cylinder shading, motion blur while it spins), the drums landing left to right, the last at frame 42; the unit in the accent beside them and what it counts (text) in tracked caps under it.

templates.name: Reservoir Cross-Section
templates.description: A canyon reservoir in cross-section, the rock in strata running off both edges: the water falls from full pool (total, when said) to the level said, leaving a pale bathtub ring on the walls, and lands at frame 46 while the level counts in a plate at the right; full pool and any thresholds (items, 'minimum power pool') are dashed across with their labels, the drop bracketed with its feet. label 'up' fills it from below instead. For a lake or reservoir elevation (the planner's _LOOK_NEEDS).

templates.name: Globe Dive
templates.description: A lit globe turns to the place, then dives: globe, region, then the real ground (USGS imagery in the US, Blue Marble elsewhere, graded dark and cool), the state's outline dashed as the imagery takes over; the marker lands at frame 68 and the place is named on a glass plate with its region and coordinates.

templates.name: Terrain Pin (Monochrome)
templates.description: A monochrome terrain push onto the place: the imagery graded as relief (navy shadows, paper highlights), a soft spotlight on it, survey hairlines closing in from the edges and a ring tightening; the marker lands at frame 34 and the name, region and coordinates come in beside it.

templates.name: Route Draw
templates.description: Two places framed on graded imagery: the route bows from the first to the second with a glowing head and direction marks, the second marker lands at frame 48, both are named, and the distance sits in a tag at the route's middle (the figure said, else the straight-line miles).

templates.name: Measured Distance
templates.description: A surveyor's dimension line between two places on graded imagery and a faint grid: extension lines from both markers, the line growing out from its middle to arrowheads, the distance counting in a tag set along it and landing at frame 44 (the figure said, else straight-line miles); both places named.

templates.name: Region Pulse
templates.description: A clean vector map (the lower 48 on an Albers projection, or the country's neighbours): the state or country named (text) or holding the place fills in the accent and its outline pulses outward three times from frame 22 while the camera leans in; its name (label, else the state's) and a line (subtitle) beside it.

templates.name: Path Trace (Numbered Stops)
templates.description: Three to eight places in order on graded imagery: one smooth line flows through them, a numbered stop popping as it reaches each (the last at frame 60) with its name on a small plate, then a gentle flow runs along the finished line. A soft pop per stop.

templates.name: Pull-Back Reveal
templates.description: The reverse of a zoom: from the ground at the place (its marker pulsing) the camera pulls up and out until the whole country is in view, the imagery handing over to a clean vector map with the place's state lit in the accent; it lands at frame 66 and the place is named - where in the world this is.

templates.name: Article Zoom (Sentence Highlight)
templates.description: VidRush's most used look, rebuilt: a newspaper page in Newsreader on the blurred, darkened clip - the publication as a plain masthead (subtitle, only when named), the headline (text), two columns with the scene's picture - the camera pushes from the top of the page down to the key sentence (highlight) while everything else falls out of focus, and a highlighter sweeps it line by line from frame 40. The page's other lines are the narration's own sentences (body), never filler text.

templates.name: Official Memo (Redacted, Stamped)
templates.description: A typed agency memo on aged paper: the agency (subtitle) over a rule, the document's kind (label), the subject (text); redaction bars slam across word runs of the surrounding lines (never the key sentence), a worn FILE COPY stamp lands at frame 28, the camera pushes in and the key sentence (highlight) is marked.

templates.name: Report Cover (Opens to the Line)
templates.description: A bound report on the desk: its dark cover holds long enough to read the issuer (subtitle), the title (text) and its kind (label), swings open on its spine, and the camera pushes onto the first page where the key sentence (highlight) is highlighted from frame 46.

templates.name: Handwritten Note
templates.description: A torn notebook page slides in on the right, fitted to its words, and the phrase is written on its rules in a pen hand (Caveat), letter by letter at the typing contract's pace (frame 6 on, 2 frames a letter), a soft pen sound for exactly that span.

templates.name: Keyword Stack
templates.description: The line's words stacked left in heavy Anton caps, two to four lines of one to three words: solid white, a hollow outline, the key word (highlight, else the last line) in the accent - each rising out of its own mask, one light sweep across them, then each slides back up into its mask. No bar, no underline; a feathered shade keeps it legible.

templates.name: Portrait Quote
templates.description: A magazine pull quote on the darkened clip: the speaker's own portrait (the scene's picture) in monochrome on the left, a large accent quote mark, the quote in Instrument Serif rising line by line, then the name (label) and role (subtitle). Without a picture the quote takes the frame alone.

templates.name: Alert Strip
templates.description: A tasteful alert, always top-left: a slim dark-glass strip wipes in, a softly pulsing dot and the label (BREAKING / WARNING / ALERT) in the accent, then the line (at most about 56 characters) slides in white. No red bar behind the words; it wipes back out to the left.

templates.name: Definition Card
templates.description: A dictionary entry, low left on a glass plate fitted to its words: a small accent kicker (label, else DEFINITION), the term (text) in Instrument Serif rising out of its mask, and what it means (subtitle) in two or three lines - only the narration's own explanation, never one made up.

templates.name: Signed Letter
templates.description: A letter's excerpt in italic Newsreader on aged, folded paper, fitted to its words; the signature (label) is written in ink from frame 26 with a pen sound for its stroke, the printed name and role (subtitle) under it. For a line that says someone wrote or signed (the planner's _LOOK_NEEDS).

templates.name: Social Post
templates.description: A dark post card with no platform's branding, tilting up into place on the blurred clip: initials in an accent avatar, who posted (label) and their handle (subtitle, only when given), the words lighting up in reading order with the key phrase (highlight) in the accent, the picture when one was added. No made-up counts. For a line that says it was posted (the planner's _LOOK_NEEDS).

templates.name: River Trace
templates.description: A named river (or canal) drawn on real geography: graded imagery under a dark veil, the camera eases onto the feature, the line draws from its source with a soft glow and the water streaming down it, then its name settles along the line. Geometry comes only from the plan (overlay.geo, src/automaps.py): never from a language model. Canals are dashed, an approximate route.

templates.name: Reservoir Fill
templates.description: A lake or reservoir on real geography: graded imagery under a dark veil, the camera eases onto the water, its real outline fills with a soft glow and the dam named in the line is pinned where it stands with a small label; the river that feeds it runs faintly through. Geometry comes only from the plan (overlay.geo, src/automaps.py).

templates.name: Figure in Context
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. The figure big in Anton (caps ~104 px at 1080p), its unit beside it on the baseline ('40 MILLION'), the digits rolling on odometer columns with a vertical motion blur and landing left to right (frame 25); then the rest of its sentence as said rises under it in Playfair Display italic, word by word ('people depend on this one river'; subtitle, else what it counts). A corner shade lifts it off any picture; the glyphs drop back into their masks at the end. A soft tick per digit change, a soft click on the landing.

templates.name: The Frame Is the Gauge
templates.description: FULL FRAME. The picture itself is the gauge: a white hairline the height of the frame sweeps in from the left to the share (22 % of the width for 22 %), the rest of the frame drains to grey, a scale of unlabelled ticks along the top, an accent dot on the line; the count rides beside the line on the bright side, what it is under it (frame 29). For a share of a whole: '22 percent full', '85 percent of Arizona's water'.

templates.name: Ring and Label
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. A precise ring (a tick bezel, a gradient arc with a bright head) fills round the percent while it counts (4 -> 28); what it is in Anton caps beside it on up to two balanced lines, a small line under them.

templates.name: Then to Now
templates.description: CENTRE. Two figures of one thing: the earlier one smaller, ghosting back as the later one lands; an accent arrow draws from one to the other, both count up, the title over them, the change under them only when it was said (subtitle: 'DOWN 181 FEET'). items [{label, value}, {label, value}], the unit on the overlay or each item.

templates.name: Money Slot Reels
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. Money on slot-machine reels: the digits spin with a heavy motion blur and stop one by one with a small bounce, the $ small and amber at the cap top, the scale word (BILLION) rising into its own slot as the last reel stops (frame 27); a raw 4,200,000,000 is written 4.2 BILLION. What it pays for under it.

templates.name: Dimension Line
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. An engineer's dimension line: extension ticks grow, the line draws out from the middle and its arrowheads land, the measurement counts in its gap with its unit in the accent ('186 MILES'); upright beside the figure for a height, a depth or a level said ('3,517 FT' above sea level). What it measures under it.

templates.name: Framed Callout
templates.description: LEFT THIRD (the box's left edge at 12 % of the width, its middle at 44 % of the height). VidRush's framed glass box: its accent edge draws round from the top left over a smoky fill that softens the picture, the figure counts inside, what it is under it in Anton caps; with overlay.anchor a dashed accent leader runs to that point in the picture and a ring settles on it.

templates.name: Two Framed Callouts
templates.description: CENTRE. Two framed glass boxes at a quarter and three quarters of the width: the first (white edge) counts, a dashed accent line with an arrowhead draws to the second (accent edge), which counts; each label over its figure, the change on the line when it was said. Before and after, two estimates, two sums.

templates.name: Two Figures on One Scale
templates.description: CENTRE. A scale draws across the frame; two pins rise from it at the two figures (the first white, the second in the accent), each figure counting over its pin with its label; the gap between them is bracketed and named when it was said ('33 FEET TO SPARE'). For two levels, two thresholds, a figure against a limit.

templates.name: Record Line
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. A dashed record line draws across, the record as said over it in the accent ('LOWEST SINCE THE DAM WAS FILLED'); the figure breaks down through it from above (a record low) or up through it (a high), the line dipping where it passes, and lands under it with a small settle (frame 26), an accent arrow beside it, what it is under it.

templates.name: Rate as a Fraction
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. A rate written as a fraction: the figure counts over a white hairline that draws under it, the rate as said beneath in the accent ('PER PERSON', 'A DAY') with a small line icon drawing itself (a person, a home, a calendar, a clock, a field); what it is in small caps under it.

templates.name: Ranking Rows
templates.description: CENTRE. A ranking (GoMotion's bar ranking, quieter): up to five rows slide in by rank, each with its rank number, its name in tracked caps and a thin bar growing to scale (the first in the accent), the values counting at the right; the title over them.

templates.name: Sentence With Its Figure
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. The sentence as said in clean Anton caps on up to two balanced lines, word by word; its figure sits in place in the accent and counts as it arrives ('LAKE MEAD SUPPLIES WATER TO 25 MILLION PEOPLE'), a soft glow as it lands. highlight (the sentence) else text.

templates.name: Document Spotlight
templates.description: A document set in real type (its kind as a kicker, the headline in Source Serif, the narration's sentence as its body) lands on a dark desk; the camera pushes in and leans toward the key words, a hand-drawn loop circles them (frame 30 -> 52; a phrase over two lines gets a hand underline per line) and a callout with a leader line names them (frame 54). For a report, records, a study, a newspaper or a law the line cites.

templates.name: Photo Focus
templates.description: The still fills the frame; from frame 10 the camera eases in on its subject (a reviewed anchor, else the frame's centre), the edges fall back into shade, a hand-drawn ring circles the subject (frame 34 -> 56) and a callout with a leader line names it (frame 54) when the line names it.

templates.name: Graph Build
templates.description: The line's own figures on dark glass: three or more years as a line that draws in (frames 12 -> 60, cubic in-out) with its area filling behind, each point popping and its value counting up as the line reaches it, the last point ringed with the change since the first; other figures as bars growing in turn, the largest in the accent and ringed. Title and unit above.

templates.name: Map Path
templates.description: Two places on a dark vector map (the states, else the countries): the camera starts close on the first, pin and name, and travels out to a view of both (frames 8 -> 52) while the route draws along the great circle (frames 20 -> 62) with a soft glow and a bright head; the second pin lands as the route arrives, then its name and the distance (as said, else straight-line miles).

templates.name: Number Reveal
templates.description: One figure, big and low on the footage over a feathered shade: what it counts in small tracked caps in the accent, the number counting up in Anton with tabular figures (frames 6 -> 40), its unit beside it, an accent rule drawing under it and one line of what it means (subtitle). Left, or right with align.

templates.name: Aperture Open
templates.description: A camera iris of eight satin-black blades, closed on frame 0, opens on the photo (3 -> 17, the shutter on 6) while the picture settles from soft and dim to sharp; the caption (label kicker, text, subtitle) rises lower left from 16; the iris closes on the picture over the last 11 frames. A portrait photo sits whole over a blurred copy of itself.

templates.name: Slit of Light
templates.description: A line of warm light grows across the black (1 -> 10) and splits into a band that opens on the photo (10 -> 25, the whoosh on 10), its lit edges fading as it opens; the caption rises lower left from 20. At the exit the band closes back to the line over the footage.

templates.name: Colour Bloom
templates.description: The photo in black and white; from frame 4 its colour spreads back out of the point (overlay.anchor, else the upper middle) like a wash, half way at 18 (a shimmer), the whole frame by 34, while the camera pushes slowly; the caption rises lower left from 22. For a line about something coming back.

templates.name: Diagonal Slices
templates.description: The photo arrives as five slanted slices sliding in along their own edges, from above and below in turn (0 -> 24, the first landing at 10), the gaps closing 18 -> 30 into one picture that keeps pushing; the caption rises lower left from 26. At the exit the slices slide out the other way over the footage.

templates.name: Waterline
templates.description: Water rises over the photo to a level (overlay.anchor.y, else 0.4 of the frame) over 2 -> 26, the rock still reading through it; a dashed white waterline draws across (24 -> 38) and its tag rises at the right: the engineers' water-level mark, label (else text) in Anton, subtitle (a height said, '3,708 FT') under it; then the water drains away and the line stays. For a line about where the water used to stand.

templates.name: Detail Inset
templates.description: The picture dims as a white box draws round a detail (overlay.anchor {x, y[, r]}, 4 -> 14); an enlarged inset grows out of the box into the open half of the frame on two leader lines (12 -> 25, landing at 22), the label inside it low left (subtitle or label kicker in the accent, text in Anton). At the exit the inset folds back into the box.

templates.name: Rangefinder Shot
templates.description: The photo seen through a rangefinder's window: frame lines, the split-image circle coming together as it focuses (3 -> 16); the shutter blinks on frames 18-19 (the click) and the picture is there full frame under a soft flash; the caption rises lower left from 24.

templates.name: Torn Strips
templates.description: The print, torn into three strips with white fibrous edges, slides in from alternate sides (landing at 15, 19 and 23); the torn seams stay a little open, handmade; the caption rises lower left from 24. At the exit the strips slide out the way they came, over the footage.

templates.name: Folded Print
templates.description: A print folded in three rises onto a dark desk (0 -> 12); its front panel opens toward the viewer (5 -> 19) and the back one from behind (9 -> 23), shading as they turn; it lies open by 23 with its creases left in the paper; the caption rises from 24 under it; the camera leans in.

templates.name: Field Journal
templates.description: An open field notebook on a desk: the print drops onto the left page (2 -> 12) and two strips of tape go on (12 -> 16, the tape on 13); on the right page the name (text) is handwritten from 17, the subtitle after it, the label (a date or place) in the corner, and a pencil arrow draws from the words to the print.

templates.name: Magazine Spread
templates.description: A glossy magazine slides onto the desk and lands at 12, opened on its opener spread: the photo bled across both pages and the fold, the kicker (label) in the accent, the headline (text) in a serif and the deck (subtitle) in italic on the picture's own shade; a gloss sweeps across the page (10 -> 36) and the camera glides in.

templates.name: Postcard
