templates.description: A vintage postcard slides in on its back - POST CARD, a stamp of the picture, a postmark with the place and the year said, the subtitle handwritten - and turns over (12 -> 26, the flip on 22) onto the picture with its printed caption (text · label) in the white border, then settles. A portrait photo makes an upright card. At the exit it slides away up and to the left.

templates.name: Contact Sheet
templates.description: A black-and-white contact sheet - three strips of the roll, frame numbers on the film edge - on a dark desk; a red grease pencil boxes one frame (6 -> 18), the camera pushes into it (20 -> 38) as it turns into the photo in colour, full frame; the caption rises lower left from 40.

templates.name: Negative to Print
templates.description: The photo lies on a light table as a colour negative - orange film base, sprocket holes, its neighbours either side - drifting (0 -> 15); a flash flips it to the positive at 16 and the film falls away as it fills the frame (18 -> 34); the caption rises lower left from 34.

templates.name: Darkroom Print
templates.description: Under the red safelight a blank print in the developing tray comes up as a black-and-white picture (2 -> 22), the developer rocking over it; the room light comes on at 24 (the switch) and the camera leans in; the caption rises lower left from 28.

templates.name: Slide Projector
templates.description: A projector lamp lights an empty screen in a dark room; the slide drops in at 6 (the slide changer) with a flicker and pulls into focus by 22 through a beam of drifting dust, warm, falling off at the corners; the caption rises under the screen from 24.

templates.name: Archive Scan
templates.description: A faded, dusty print lies on a scanner's glass; the light bar runs down it (6 -> 26) and leaves it restored behind; the scan then fills the frame (28 -> 42; a portrait whole over its blurred copy); the caption rises lower left from 42.

templates.name: Shutter Burst
templates.description: Three frames of a burst, each closer on the point (overlay.anchor, else the middle): wide, the shutter blinks on 8-9, closer, blinks on 18-19, closest from 20 and still easing in; never closer than the picture's own pixels allow. The caption rises lower left from 22.

templates.name: Album Page
templates.description: A glassine interleaf lifts off an old album page (2 -> 17, clearing the print at 14): the deckle-edged print held in four black photo corners, a typed label under it (text, and the year said); the camera leans in.

templates.name: Archive Stamp
templates.description: An aged sepia print with a typed caption (text — year) slides onto the desk (0 -> 11); the stamp's shadow closes in and a red ARCHIVE rubber stamp (or a short label word) with the year comes down on its lower corner at 14, inked unevenly, the print giving a little under it; the camera leans in.

templates.name: Book Plate
templates.description: An old book lies open; its right-hand page turns over in 3D (2 -> 18, landing at ~16) onto a full-page photographic plate in a ruled frame, its caption set in small caps (text) and italic (subtitle or label) beneath; the camera leans in toward the plate.

templates.name: Archive Envelope
templates.description: A kraft archive envelope with a typed label (text, subtitle or label) and a red PHOTOGRAPH / DO NOT BEND stamp lies on the desk; the print slides half out of it (4 -> 20), then the envelope drops to the foot of the frame (16 -> 34) as the print settles above it, whole, the label still in view.

templates.name: Drying Line
templates.description: In a dim darkroom the print slides along the drying line on its wooden clothes-pegs and stops at 16 (the peg), swinging to rest; prints either side hang out of focus; the caption rises lower left from 22.

templates.name: Dated Prints
templates.description: Two or three prints (media) land in turn along a time rail, the last at 25, each over its date (items[i].label, in Anton) and an accent tick, the rail drawing across; the title (text) and kicker (label) sit top left. At the exit the prints slide away to the left.

templates.name: Then / Now
templates.description: The earlier picture (media[0]) fills the frame; a lit diagonal seam sweeps in from the left and settles in the middle (4 -> 20), the later picture (media[1]) on its right, each side's date (items[0] / items[1] label, else THEN / NOW) at its top corner, the title lower left; at the exit the seam runs on and the later picture takes the frame. One picture: its earlier side in sepia.

templates.name: Real Data Line
templates.description: FULL SCREEN, REAL DATA. A line chart of the official numbers over time (overlay.data from src/datagraphics.py: USBR, USGS, the U.S. Drought Monitor, NOAA - never the narration's or a model's numbers): the title and the metric top-left, a quiet axis, the line draws left to right with a soft glow and the area under it filling, the reference levels the source states dashed (full pool, minimum power pool, dead pool), the start of the window marked small, then the latest reading lands with a pulse and its value and date called out beside it, the change since the start in a chip. 'SOURCE: USBR · DATA AS OF OCT 3, 2026' rises in the low corner in the source tag's own line. Placed only by the real data path (config.DATA_GRAPHICS), on the fact's first word.

templates.name: Real Data Number
templates.description: FULL SCREEN, REAL DATA. One official number, big: the latest reading counts up in Anton with its unit (6,580 CFS, 5.19 MAF), the station or reservoir and the metric above it, its date under it, and a sparkline of the series beneath that draws to the same reading, the change since the start of the window in a chip. The source and the date of the data rise in the low corner in the source tag's line. Data only from overlay.data (src/datagraphics.py). Placed only by the real data path (config.DATA_GRAPHICS).

templates.name: Real Data Bars
templates.description: FULL SCREEN, REAL DATA. Comparison bars of official numbers on a true zero: for drought, the share of the area in drought and in each worse category this week (U.S. Drought Monitor), the category the narration names in the accent; the bars grow in turn with their values counting, the highlighted one landing last with a click. The source and the date of the data rise in the low corner in the source tag's line. Data only from overlay.data (src/datagraphics.py). Placed only by the real data path (config.DATA_GRAPHICS).

templates.name: Real Data Fill Gauge
templates.description: FULL SCREEN, REAL DATA. A reservoir's fill level: a tall glass vessel with 0-100% marks fills with water to the share of live capacity the agency's own storage gives (USBR), its surface rippling, last year's level a dashed ghost line; beside it the share counts up in Anton, 'OF LIVE CAPACITY', the storage in million acre-feet out of the capacity, and the date of the reading. The source and the date rise in the low corner in the source tag's line. Data only from overlay.data (src/datagraphics.py). Placed only by the real data path (config.DATA_GRAPHICS).

templates.name: Source Tag
templates.description: LOW CORNER. The citation for a fact whose source the narration names: one thin rule draws out from the corner, then 'SOURCE: USBR, 2024' rises under it in small tracked caps (label = 'Source'; text = the source as said, or the short form viewers know; subtitle = the year, only when the narration says it). No box, no band: white on the picture with a soft shadow. It holds still and leaves in its last 9 frames. align left / right picks the corner; with captions on it sits clear above them. Silent. Placed only by the planner's source pass (src/sources.py, config.SOURCE_TAGS): a source is never invented, a figure with no named source gets no tag.

templates.name: Sentence Highlight
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. VidRush's sentence highlight, refined: the spoken sentence types in a warm Playfair Display a letter at a time (no cursor) on up to three balanced lines; as its key phrase types, a marker in the video's accent wipes in under it and the phrase sets in dark italic on the marker (highlight, else the line's longest word). No bar, no underline. A soft marker stroke as it draws.

templates.name: Typewriter Lower Third
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. VidRush's type-writer lower third: the line types in cream Courier Prime Bold (cap ~31 px) from frame 6, 2 frames a letter (the typing contract), a block cursor in the accent after it; the small line under it types at a letter a frame; the cursor blinks for 24 frames and goes. A clean typewriter for the typing span.

templates.name: Kicker and Headline
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. A small kicker in tracked accent caps (label, only when given), then the headline in Anton caps on up to two balanced lines, each word rising out of its own mask a beat after the one before, the key word in the accent (highlight, else the longest); a serif italic line under it when a subtitle is given. A soft text swoosh.

templates.name: Kinetic Phrase
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. A short line word by word, each landing out of a blur with a soft overshoot: the words that carry it in Anton caps, the small words (the, of, is...) in Playfair italic, the key word in the accent; one or two balanced lines. A very soft tick as each word lands.

templates.name: Spoken Quote
templates.description: CENTRE. VidRush's quote: the frame darkens softly at its edges, the quote in Playfair Display (cap ~44 px) fades in word by word as if spoken, between accent quotation marks, balanced lines centred; who said it (label, and subtitle: their role) small and tracked under a short accent dash once it is in.

templates.name: Pull Quote
templates.description: MIDDLE LEFT. An editorial pull-quote over a soft left-side darkening: a large accent quotation mark scales in, the quote in Playfair Display rises line by line out of clean masks, the key words (highlight) in accent italic; the speaker (label) and their role (subtitle) in tracked caps under it. A soft paper slide.

templates.name: Statement Card
templates.description: RIGHT, vertically centred. An official statement on a dark glass card (a frosted fill that softens the picture, a hairline edge) sliding in from the right: the source as its header in accent tracked caps beside a small dot (label), the statement in Playfair italic word by word, how it was given under it (subtitle: 'IN A STATEMENT'). A soft swipe.

templates.name: Name Card
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. A name in Anton caps pulled into focus (blur 12 -> 0) as its tracking closes from wide to tight, one soft light passing across it in the accent; the role under it in tracked caps, the organisation or years in the accent under that. No bar, no box.

templates.name: Question on Screen
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. The question in Playfair italic (cap ~51 px) word by word out of a soft blur, on balanced lines; its question mark drops in last in the accent with a small settle. A very soft tick per word and a soft pop on the mark.

templates.name: Contrast Statement
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. Two lines that turn on each other: the first lands word by word in white Anton caps, then steps back (smaller, dimmed) as the second rises under it in the accent, larger ('THIS IS NOT A DROUGHT' / 'IT'S THE NEW NORMAL'). items [first, second], else text and subtitle. A soft swoosh on each line.

templates.name: Ink Reveal Headline
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. A headline in Playfair Display Bold (cap ~54 px) revealed like ink soaking into paper: a soft, uneven front of blots travels across each line (the second following the first); a small accent kicker over it (label, only when given). A soft whoosh.

templates.name: Notice
templates.description: LOWER LEFT. A tasteful warning, no red bar: an accent warning triangle draws itself, its mark pops in with one soft pulse ring, the warning as said in Anton caps beside it, a small line under it (subtitle). A soft pop.
